lists.content:
Accounting

  • Own full-cycle bookkeeping in the GL, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, banking, and general journals.
  • Prepare bank reconciliations and ensure all transactions are posted and cleared within the period
  • Prepare journal entries and compile the supporting documentation behind them
  • Maintain related-party loan interest schedules
  • Process vendor payables and set up wire, ACH, and cash transfers accurately and on time
  • Prepare monthly GST remittances
  • Support quarterly and annual financial procedures, including audits and budgeting

    • Financial Reporting

  • Support senior staff in preparing quarterly working papers
  • Assist with pro forma reporting
  • Run GL variance analysis and flag items that need a second look

    • Business Operations

  • Coordinate the processing of legal documents.
  • Support the accounting and deal teams on ad hoc reporting as needed

    • Tax

  • Assist with the preparation of tax returns and working papers

• Completed post-secondary education in accounting or finance
  • CPA candidate preferred, but not essential
  • 1 to 2 years of relevant accounting or bookkeeping experience
  • Experience with accounting and tax software preferred; experience with Oracle NetSuite is a strong asset
  • Solid computer skills across word processing, spreadsheets, and databases
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to improve speed and accuracy, or genuine curiosity to learn
  • Detail-oriented, with an eye on the bigger picture behind the numbers
  • Proactive and quick to learn, adapting when priorities shift
  • Strong at multitasking and prioritizing across concurrent deadlines
  • A collaborative team player who communicates openly, positively, and with respect
  • Trusted with sensitive information and consistent in exercising discretion

lists.content:
Sales & Marketing Ops

  • Operate HubSpot day-to-day: reporting, data hygiene, workflow automation, and pipeline tracking
  • Build and maintain dashboards that surface pipeline health, conversion metrics, and campaign performance
  • Keep marketing materials organized, accessible, and current across the team
  • Identify and flag manual workflows that could be automated to improve efficiency

    • Investment Ops

  • Operate HubSpot deal tracking on the investment side, ensuring clean data from sourcing through close
  • Manage project management workflows and task tracking for deal execution, process implementations, and cross-functional initiatives
  • Maintain SharePoint document structure, governance, and accessibility of key investment documents
  • Maintain data integrity across all operational systems (HubSpot, ClickUp, SharePoint)
  • Execute on new system implementations and process changes, driving timelines and stakeholder accountability

    • People Ops

  • Build and maintain a hiring database to support recruiting operations and candidate tracking
  • Develop and maintain a structured onboarding process

    • Reporting & Data

  • Generate monthly, quarterly, and annual reports on time and with consistent accuracy
  • Assemble final deliverables across all data sources, including Addepar outputs from other team members
  • Serve as the central data steward for the business — ensure data is clean, consistent, and reliable across all systems
  • Improve and promote routine data entry standards across the team
  • Use AI tools to accelerate report generation, data cleaning, and identification of inconsistencies across systems.

    • Ad Hoc & Operational Support

  • Provide operational follow-through on ad hoc initiatives, including task tracking, status updates, and accountability loops
  • Continuously improve how you execute within existing systems, including thoughtful use of AI tools where appropriate

• 3–5 years of experience in operations, strategy & operations, revenue operations, or a similarly analytical execution role
  • Strong CRM experience (HubSpot preferred), including workflow configuration and reporting
  • Demonstrated comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to improve speed and accuracy in operational work.
  • Proven experience improving funnel visibility, reporting, or forecasting processes
  • Track record of executing structured processes and driving accountability across teams
  • Strong analytical skills with a data-first approach to problem-solving
  • Experience managing projects using tools such as ClickUp, Asana, or similar
  • High attention to detail, ownership mindset, and comfort operating with sensitive information
  • Bias towards action, with a preference for executing and refining over waiting for perfect conditions

    •  

    We thank all candidates for their interest but only those applicants selected for an interview will be contacted. No telephone calls or recruitment agencies will be accepted.

lists.content:
Operational decision support

Provide strategic decision support to Property / Asset Management

  • Analyze capital plan, budgets and cost recoveries
  • Review annual operating budgets and quarterly forecasts for each property. Support Property Managers in maximizing cost recoveries from tenants
  • Review cash flow forecasts and distribution analysis prepared by property management accountants; oversee annual budgets and liaise with property managers to ensure maximum recoveries of planned spend
  • Review and analyze lease agreements; provide recommendations and comments to management/legal
  • Oversee property assessments and liaise with external consultants to minimize property taxes
  • Recommend and implement new financial systems, controls and processes in collaboration with Asset Management and Finance teams keeping in mind operational efficiency
  • Drive efficiency in processes through detailed review of lease set up in Yardi and standardization of deliverables
  • Identify opportunities to provide value to the property manager and Leadership teams through a deep understanding of the lease/asset and business requirements

    • Accounting and Reporting

    Oversee the accounting and finance related activities for the Property Management operations and all entities that own income producing properties

  • Support year-end audit, including preparation of certain working papers, analysis and other support as required
  • Support reporting to third party investors, including quarterly investor report and cash forecast
  • Oversee all tenant billings and collections, including annual CAM reconciliation. Review and monitor tenant accounts receivable to ensure timely collection. Coach team in providing necessary support for tenant charges to reduce questions and speed up recoveries
  • Review lease new lease set up and amendments to ensure accuracy of information
  • Review financial statements and property working papers, highlighting variances and seeking answers to resolve identified issues
  • Work with project accounting to assist in the transfer of completed projects to asset management through review of cost allocation models and oversee transfer journal entries
  • Support in development of reporting dashboards for property and asset management operations

    • Leadership

  • Awareness of the unique needs and requirements of both the Finance and Property / Asset Management teams, providing leadership to both groups in an effort to support an environment of collaboration and continuous improvement. 
  • Promote culture of teamwork through assisting, coaching, and directing other staff as appropriate
  • Manage team of seven property accountants, one assistant manager, and one accounts receivable clerk
  • Helps identify gaps in capability, motivation, and/or license of team members and works with Senior Manager to develop a plan to coach team members
  • Dives into detail with the property accountant as needed to work through issues together and show them how to be successful
  • Understands the nature of competing priorities and supports the team in making reasoned choices in what to focus on week to week, and throughout the year

• University degree and accounting designation (CA, CPA, CGA, CMA)
  • Proven leader with 5 or more years’ experience in Property/Asset Management operations and accounting
  • Strong understanding of GAAP, REALpac and financial reporting requirements
  • Intermediate to advanced knowledge of MS Office
  • Experience with Yardi or other property management specific software
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a natural inclination for collaboration
  • Naturally curious with a willingness to challenge assumptions and ask the hard questions
  • An organized self-starter with a strong work ethic who is able to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment
  • Ability to prioritize work and manage multiple tasks, likely with competing priorities
  • Strong attention to detail balanced with an awareness of the bigger picture
  • Experience creating reporting dashboards in Power BI or other visualization software an asset
  • Capacity to connect with construction and development teams, understand their perspectives and communicate effectively with an operational mindset

This role will provide the business units and the executive team with timely, reliable financial insights to help the respective business leaders maximize performance while ensuring adherence to the required control and decision-making frameworks.

This is a hands-on leadership role that manages a small team, coordinates activities with other finance teams, and improves the processes and controls of the businesses.

lists.content:
Accounting and Reporting

  • Lead accounting and financial reporting for Beedie’s operating businesses, including the monthly, quarterly, and annual close; reconciliations; intercompany activity; cost allocations; fee revenue; management reporting; year-end reporting; and audit support. Own the quality and integrity of the financial records.
    • Assess direct and indirect costs relative to their recovery mechanisms and fee revenue to provide proactive insights into the profitability of each business. Oversee the development, maintenance, and review of indirect cost allocation methodologies to ensure allocations are appropriate, accurate, and in alignment with underlying business activities.
    • Own financial results and related explanations, and support FP&A’s budgeting and forecasting processes with accurate accounting information and insights. Collaborate with FP&A and business leaders to develop KPIs that support management and executive oversight of the operating businesses including labour utilization, recovery analysis, and alignment of forecast and actual business activities.
    • Support the broader finance department by leading the monthly close process,

      •  Business Partnership

      • Serve as the primary Finance partner for the leaders of Beedie’s operating businesses. Build a strong understanding of Beedie’s businesses, including the various structures, revenue and cost drivers, and reporting needs.
      • Partner with business leaders and Finance teams to explain results, provide accounting insight, and support informed decisions.
      • Oversee regulatory and licensing requirements for the real estate brokerage operations, including related specified procedure engagements. 

        • Team Leadership 

      • Lead, coach, and develop a team of accountants.
      • Establish priorities, allocate work, and maintain clear expectations for quality, service, and deadlines. 
      • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and practical problem-solving. 
      • Strengthen the team’s technical capabilities and business understanding.

        • Processes, Controls, and Continuous Improvement 

      • Apply and monitor effective accounting processes and controls, collaborating with other Finance managers and business teams to implement consistent standards and documentation.
      • Identify areas of risk and propose mitigation strategies.
      • Manage process exceptions and confirm that processes produce the intended financial and business outcomes. 
      • Drive continuous improvement by simplifying processes, improving consistency, and fixing root causes.

• CPA designation or equivalent combination of education and professional experience. 
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in full-cycle accounting, financial reporting, and multi-entity environments.
  • Proven leadership experience developing teams and partnering with business stakeholders to understand operational activities and create practical solutions.
  • Real estate, construction, property management, or activity-based costing experience is an asset.
  • Strong process-improvement mindset with the ability to implement standards, document processes, and improve consistency. 
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills with a commitment to financial accuracy and operational excellence.

Working across suppliers, project and site teams, estimating, and accounting, the Coordinator helps keep procurement information accurate, current, consistent, and easy to use.

lists.content:
Procurement Administration

  • Manage price books, non-MSA pricing requests, purchase order inquiries, subrental approvals, and invoice discrepancies.
  • Act as a primary contact for supplier onboarding, pricing, contract-administration, and procurement-process questions.
  • Coordinate issue resolution with suppliers, project and site teams, Estimating, and Accounting, escalating commercial, system, financial, or compliance matters as required.

    • Supplier Onboarding, Contracts and Compliance

  • Coordinate supplier prequalification, setup, credit applications, approvals, and required documentation across procurement and accounting systems.
  • Maintain supplier trade classifications, service areas, capacity, bid history, participation, pricing, lead-time, and market information to support tender-list development and procurement planning.
  • Track the execution, renewal, and status of Master Service Agreements, supplier documentation, compliance records, pricing, and approvals.
  • Maintain organized procurement files and investigate invoice, contract, pricing, or documentation discrepancies against approved requirements.

    • Systems Data and Reporting

  • Administer day-to-day procurement workflows and data in TradeTapp, BuildingConnected, GoFormz, Procore, Yardi, DocuSign, and related platforms.
  • Coordinate supplier setup, user access, permissions, system issues, data quality, configuration requests, testing, and workflow improvements with internal and external support teams.
  • Prepare and maintain recurring procurement reports and dashboards, including contract status, supplier allocations, purchasing activity, bidder lists, spend, MSA status, pricing, and other agreed KPIs.

    • Process Improvement and User Support

  • Maintain procurement SOPs, templates, process documentation, and training materials.
  • Provide practical onboarding, refresher training, and day-to-day guidance to project and site teams on procurement systems and procedures.
  • Identify recurring issues and implement practical improvements that strengthen consistency, governance, user adoption, and scalability.

• Previous experience in procurement, construction administration, project administration, contract administration, accounting coordination, or a similar support role.
  • Construction, development, industrial, or real-estate experience is an asset.
  • Experience with vendor-management, tendering, procurement, ERP, or accounting systems is an asset.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines, recurring reporting, and stakeholder requests.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with suppliers and cross-functional internal teams.
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including organizing and reconciling data, maintaining trackers, and preparing clear reports; proficiency with Word, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Experience with TradeTapp, BuildingConnected, Procore, GoFormz, Yardi, DocuSign, or comparable platforms is an asset.
  • Ability to learn interconnected systems, investigate workflow or data issues, exercise sound commercial judgment, and handle confidential supplier and pricing information.

lists.content:
Financial reporting and analysis

  • Prepare quarterly and annual financial reports for standalone and consolidated entities.
  • Consolidate and analyze complex entity structures, including analyzing intercompany transactions, investments, and equity.
  • Assess trial balances, subledgers, and other financial results.
  • Review internal financial information, including junior work and peer cross-reviews.
  • Review and analyze financial information for externally managed investments.
  • Prepare management reporting, dashboards, and partnership analytics (e.g., NAV, cash flow, capital activity).
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and overhead analyses.
    •  
    Close and compliance
  • Contribute to month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close responsibilities.
  • Ensure accuracy and consistency of accounting records in accordance with GAAP, including research and application of technical guidance as needed.
  • Prepare journal entries, financial reports, and review invoices; investigate and resolve discrepancies where required.
  • Liaise with external auditors and prepare supporting documentation.
  • Maintain reporting timelines and ensure timely delivery of obligations.

    •  

    Process improvement and projects

  • Identify and implement process improvements and efficiencies.
  • Support system implementations, upgrades, and reporting enhancements.
  • Contribute to team training and development initiatives.
  • Assist with special projects as assigned.

• CPA or legacy designation with a university degree.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in public practice or a complex consolidation environment.
  • Strong GAAP knowledge and the ability to apply technical guidance.
  • Advanced Excel and strong systems proficiency; experience working with large datasets and reporting tools.
  • Experience with financial analysis, management reporting, and audit readiness.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Effective communicator with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A team player with strong interpersonal skills capable of collaborating with multiple stakeholders.
  • The following are assets:
  • Real estate or asset-intensive industry experience
  • Familiarity with REALpac
  • Knowledge of ASPE framework
  • Experience with Yardi, CaseWare
  • Exposure to Power BI, automation, or AI tools

Responsible for managing acquisition opportunities, the approval process, and contributing to the construction and eventual lease or sale of industrial projects in Ontario from conception through stabilization.. With the support of the BC & Alberta Development Team, this individual will guide the due diligence review of land and building acquisitions, manage and edit development proformas, review of legal contracts, manage and engage consultants and preparation, submission and negotiation for site plan approval, draft plan approval and permitting.

lists.content:
• Manage the land acquisitions process by reviewing zoning bylaws, restrictive covenants, design guidelines and preliminary design drawings.
  • Visit prospective land opportunities to assess existing conditions, prepare a comprehensive condition assessment report, and identify any site‐specific extraordinary costs.
  • Review due diligence packages including geotechnical and environmental reports and obtain site preparation budgets.
  • Communicate with brokerage community on a regular basis to answer questions regarding acquisitions and proposed developments.
  • Meet with potential clients regarding build‐to‐suit purchases, leases and condo purchases.
  • Lead the consultant team with submission and rezoning applications, land subdivision and development permits and coordinate with municipal planning and building departments.
  • Expedite the resolution of all site plan approval or draft plan approval issues which arise to maintain project schedules and the level of quality of each project.
  • Participate in the RFP process by reviewing proposals and reviewing pre‐construction building specifications.
  • Lead site plan, draft plan, and building permit approvals.
  • Work with development team to generate building layouts for built‐to‐suit and speculative developments.
  • Participate in design meetings to analyze plans and specifications for coordination, constructability, value engineering, and completeness.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with relevant consultants.
  • Assist asset management team when required.
  • Assist the development team on scope and process questions throughout involvement of contractor.
  • Work closely with development, construction, sales, investment, asset management and property management teams to facilitate successful projects..
  • Establish key relationships with city staff in relevant jurisdictions.
  • Manage development proformas as a tool to schedule, consolidate budgets, present to senior leadership and assist in making business decisions.
  • Oversee and manage project budget approvals, budget management, and project reporting to ownership.

• Experience as a development manager in land and building development cycles.
  • Experience with reviewing proformas for purchasing, selling and leasing commercial properties.
  • Experience in working with municipal departments for rezoning, draft plans, site plans and building permit applications.
  • Strong understanding of legal contracts and title documents.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience as Development Manager.
  • Knowledge of the SPA, Draft Plan and BP process in a variety of municipalities and other city approvals.
  • Experience with land due diligence review, and managing tasks on multiple, concurrent projects.
  • Post‐secondary education in a related discipline.
  • Excellent communication skills, combined with proven presentation experience within a senior level management group.
  • A track record of establishing highly functional relationships with diverse personalities both within and outside the company.
  • Proficient in Excel, Word and Outlook as well as preferred knowledge of scheduling software.
  • Good knowledge of the Ontario building code.
  • Ability to evaluate multiple development paths (zoning strategy, phasing, servicing approach, tenant requirements) and select the option that optimizes risk-adjusted returns.
  • Ability to break complex, ambiguous development problems into manageable components
  • Asks questions that expose assumptions in consultant work, municipal feedback, and internal estimates.

With the support of the BC & Alberta Development Team, this individual will guide the due diligence review of land and building acquisitions, manage and edit development proformas, review of legal contracts, manage and engage consultants and preparation, submission and negotiation for site plan approval, draft plan approval and permitting.
